title: High-stability spherical lanthanide nanoclusters for magnetic resonance imaging

synthesis.procedure: N-Methylbenzimidazole-2-methanol (HL), HoCl3·6H2O and triethylamine were dissolved in methanol and acetonitrile. The solution was stirred for 0.5 h, transferred to a Teflon container in a stainless-steel bomb, and heated at 100 °C for 48 h. It was then filtered and left to evaporate, yielding yellow crystals.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solvothermal synthesis in a Teflon container inside a stainless-steel bomb
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; solution allowed to stand and evaporate to give yellow crystals.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, “Synthesis and structure analysis of Ln clusters,” Fig. 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A spherical Ho32 core contains Ho(III) ions on its surface, linked through μ3-OH and μ4-O bridges. Twenty-four peripheral L ligands wrap the core; eight chloride ions coordinate to the cluster and four chloride counterions lie outside it.

synthesis.procedure: The Ho32 procedure was repeated with GdCl3·6H2O in place of HoCl3·6H2O: HL, the gadolinium salt and triethylamine were dissolved in methanol and acetonitrile, stirred for 0.5 h, and heated in a Teflon-lined stainless-steel bomb at 100 °C for 48 h. Filtration and evaporation afforded yellow crystals.

reagents.name: N-Methylbenzimidazole-2-methanol (HL)
reagents.amount: 0.1 mmol, 148 mg (as printed for the shared procedure)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solvothermal synthesis in a Teflon container inside a stainless-steel bomb
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; solution allowed to stand and evaporate to give yellow crystals.

properties.summary: The cluster showed strong T1-weighted MRI contrast in solution, 4T1 cells and tumor-bearing mice. At the same administered Gd(III) concentration, its tumor contrast exceeded that of Gd-DTPA.

measurements.name: Relative tumor MR signal
measurements.conditions: 12 h after tail-vein injection of 100 μL containing 0.5 mM Gd(III) into BALB/c mice bearing 4T1 tumors; 1 T imaging

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, “Synthesis and structure analysis of Ln clusters,” Fig. 1
Results and Discussion, “In vitro relaxivity and MRI performance” and “In vivo tumor MRI performance,” Figs 4–5

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Gd32 homologue is described as a spherical cluster with Ln(III) ions on the surface, μ3-OH and μ4-O bridges in the core, and peripheral L ligands wrapping the cluster.
